subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw authorize these upgraded third-party GitHub Action revisions for workflows that receive application private keys, GitHub tokens, Docker credentials, and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The patch is a scoped dependency update, but deciding whether revised workflow actions may execute with repository credentials is a trust-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve verified revisions
options.body: Verify the immutable upstream revisions and authorize this grouped update for the credential-bearing workflows.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Keep ordinary CI action updates separate and request individual review for the app-token and Codex-action revisions.

options.title: Pause the group update
options.body: Hold this Dependabot PR until the CI security policy defines an approved action-update process for credential-bearing workflows.

recommendation.title: Approve verified revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the immutable upstream revisions and authorize this grouped update for the credential-bearing workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns repository-wide CI and release workflow trust boundaries rather than the Dependabot branch itself.
